descriptionPlain:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer II to join Spotify's Platform Central Data (PCD) squad, a cross-functional Data Engineering and Analytics Engineering team within the Platform Mission. You’ll help build and maintain trusted analytical models, metrics, and data products that power developer productivity, platform health, and leadership decision-making. Working closely with Data Engineers, Product, Engineering, and Platform partners, you’ll translate platform signals into reliable, well-modeled data assets that help Spotify ship faster and safer.

Working closely with Data Engineers, Product, Engineering, and Platform partners, you’ll translate platform signals into reliable, well-modeled data assets that help Spotify ship faster and safer.

lists.content:
• Build and maintain analytical data models using dbt (or similar SQL-based transformation frameworks) in BigQuery for a broad set of stakeholders
  • Build and operate reliable data pipelines using SQL, with a focus on testing, observability, and CI/CD
  • Help define and evolve key metrics for platform health, developer productivity, and ML/AI platform adoption
  • Partner with Data Engineers on upstream pipelines and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to scope and deliver insights
  • Improve data quality, performance, and cost efficiency across pipelines and models, including troubleshooting and backfills
  • Contribute to dashboards and self-serve data products that enable better decision-making across teams
  • Follow and contribute to data quality, testing, and documentation practices across the analytics layer
  • Participate in a fair support rotation for key datasets, pipelines, and analytical products

• You have 2+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related field
  • You have strong SQL skills and experience with data modelling
  • You are experienced with dbt (or similar SQL-based transformation frameworks) and a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks SQL
  • You are familiar with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or Flyte
  • You care about data quality, reliability, and testability
  • You are comfortable working with BI/visualisation tools such as Looker or Tableau
  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners
  • You are able to prioritize and deliver in a fast-moving environment
  • You have experience with platform or developer productivity data, experimentation, or ML/AI metrics

This role is based in London or Stockholm. 
 
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
Security engineers at Spotify protect the security of Spotify’s platform and of our 750+ million users. We are looking for an experienced engineer to join us in securing the most important engineering initiatives at Spotify.
You will be working in the infrastructure security engineering area to secure the foundations of Spotify’s platform. We’re a distributed team building the architecture and foundations for secure cloud computing and support platform teams in building best-in-class infrastructure on it. We aim to constantly improve the security posture for our fast-paced and rapidly-changing environment in a manner that will keep up with our scale. We’re experts in many domains of security, willing to teach and learn from anyone at the company.
You are a seasoned security, systems or software engineer with a passion for cloud security. Above all you have an insatiable appetite for learning new things and honing your existing skill set. In this role you are expected to represent security in various engineering and business contexts so we expect you to be comfortable communicating with diverse audiences both verbally and in writing.

lists.content:
• Champion and contribute to the development and implementation of security best practices, standards, and automated tooling to secure Spotify’s use of cloud computing.
  • Partner closely with teams across the company to integrate security seamlessly into Spotify’s infrastructure, from ideation to deployment and monitoring.
  • Consult, evangelize, and teach theoretical and practical security to groups of varying sizes, disciplines, and experience levels.
  • Drive cross-disciplinary initiatives to improve the security of Spotify’s engineering ecosystem and infrastructure.
  • Conduct threat modeling, security reviews, and risk assessments to make risk-informed security decisions and recommendations.
  • Evaluate, prototype, and integrate security solutions and tools to secure Spotify’s cloud environment.
  • Stay ahead of the curve on the rapidly evolving landscape of security threats, academic research, vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies relevant to Spotify's scale and domain.
  • Contribute to security incident response activities involving Spotify platforms and systems.

• 3+ years of hands-on technical experience with security engineering and cloud computing.
  • Hands-on security experience and expertise with one or more major cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS or Azure.
  • You are confident in automating your work in languages like Python, Java, or Golang with modern software development practices.
  • You are comfortable with infrastructure-as-code and declarative configuration management.
  • You have hands-on experience with operating and securing Kubernetes or similar container orchestration platforms.
  • Strong foundation with security skills such as cryptography, IAM, threat modeling and software security.
  • You are comfortable working with diverse stakeholders and explaining security concepts to non-expert audiences.
  • You have experience from working in agile environments and easily adapt to change, enjoy challenges and thrive in ambiguity.
  • Experience with applying generative AI tools to security problems and software engineering tasks.
  • Experience integrating security tooling into production systems at scale.

• This role is based in Stockholm or London.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
Think it, build it, ship it, tweak it" is at the core of Spotify's product development approach. In the Experimentation product area we are providing Spotify and external customers with Confidence, our platform to quickly and safely iterate through ideas, learn from them and make informed decisions for better products.
 
At Spotify, experimentation touches almost all of our functions from marketing via content management to consumer products, and we’re running several thousands of tests every year. Through confidence, we 're sharing all our findings and practices with more companies as a commercial SaaS product.
 
The team you will manage is a skilled and highly engaged group of engineers that are distributed over Europe. As an Engineering manager, you coach them individually and as a team, maintaining their strong team culture and helping them thrive and and grow. Your technical experience provides mentorship and guidelines to the team, which ensures quality and timeliness of your deliveries. Your leadership promotes creativity, collaboration and courage, which forms a kind and productive team with a high bar for quality and pace of delivery.

descriptionPlain:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We’re building one of Spotify’s most social and engaging experiences: Jam. Jam brings people together through music, enabling friends and groups to listen in real time, wherever they are. It transforms listening from a solo activity into a shared experience and plays an important role in how Spotify connects users through audio.
You’ll join a cross-functional team working across mobile, backend, and platform technologies to shape how millions of people experience music together.

At Spotify, we’re building a workplace where people can do their best work, wherever they are in the world. The Global Workplace Services team focuses on supporting our rapidly growing business by creating environments, services, and programs that help Spotify thrive. As part of our broader Business Protection function, you'll play a critical role in protecting our people and enabling our leaders to operate confidently around the globe.
We're looking for an Executive Protection Specialist to join our team in Stockholm. This is a unique opportunity for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys international travel, and is passionate about protecting people through thoughtful planning, operational excellence, and strong judgment. You'll become a trusted partner to Spotify’s leadership team, helping ensure their safety and security wherever business takes them.

descriptionPlain:
Spotify is looking for a commercially minded FP&A Manager to serve as the dedicated finance partner for our Distribution Partnerships team. Distribution Partnerships play an important role in Spotify's growth strategy by working with strategic partners to expand user acquisition, deepen engagement, and improve retention through innovative distribution and marketing initiatives.
In this role, you'll build the financial foundations that help shape partnership decisions. You'll develop robust business cases, subscriber models, and end-to-end P&L analyses that connect user growth with business outcomes. You'll partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate opportunities, challenge assumptions, and provide insights that help leaders make confident, data-informed decisions.
description:
Spotify is looking for a commercially minded FP&A Manager to serve as the dedicated finance partner for our Distribution Partnerships team. Distribution Partnerships play an important role in Spotify's growth strategy by working with strategic partners to expand user acquisition, deepen engagement, and improve retention through innovative distribution and marketing initiatives.

In this role, you'll build the financial foundations that help shape partnership decisions. You'll develop robust business cases, subscriber models, and end-to-end P&L analyses that connect user growth with business outcomes. You'll partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate opportunities, challenge assumptions, and provide insights that help leaders make confident, data-informed decisions.

lists.content:
• Lead business case development for Distribution Partnerships by building investment models that combine subscriber forecasts, partnership economics, and full P&L impact.
  • Develop financial frameworks that evaluate new and existing partnerships, including lifetime value, payback periods, return on investment, and other key performance metrics.
  • Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and risks that inform partnership strategy and investment decisions.
  • Partner closely with Distribution Partnerships, Accounting, Business Affairs, Legal, Strategy, and other cross-functional teams to translate financial insights into clear recommendations for business and senior leaders.
  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve reporting for the partnership portfolio, including KPIs, performance tracking, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • Support annual planning, quarterly forecasting, and ongoing financial planning activities by partnering with business leaders to establish data-driven targets.
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting, and tooling to help Spotify evaluate and manage partnerships more effectively.

• You have 5+ years of experience in FP&A, Strategy & Analytics, Investment Banking, Corporate Finance, or a similar analytical role. Experience in a consumer subscription business is a plus.
  • You have experience building sophisticated financial models and performing scenario analysis in environments with evolving information and changing priorities.
  • You know how to translate commercial agreements into meaningful financial outcomes and have experience partnering with Legal, Business Affairs, commercial, or deal teams.
  • You are comfortable working with large datasets. Experience with SQL is preferred, and you are interested in applying AI tools to improve financial analysis and decision-making.
  • You balance strong attention to detail with sound judgment, knowing when additional analysis will meaningfully improve a decision and when it is time to move forward.
  • You manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining a high standard of quality in a fast-moving environment.
  • You are naturally curious and enjoy exploring problems beyond the initial question to uncover insights that create business value.
  • You communicate complex financial concepts clearly and tailor your recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• For this role, the preferred locations are Stockholm or London. 
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best!  We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.

description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

The Multilingual AI Data Quality space is part of Spotify's Global Language Quality Program within Localization. Bringing together multilingual language quality evaluation and AI data quality, the team helps ensure our AI-powered experiences are accurate, culturally relevant, and trustworthy across languages and markets.

Working closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Research, Personalization, Localization, vendors, and market experts, the team develops evaluation methodologies, high-quality datasets, and quality signals that help improve AI experiences and inform product decisions at scale.

lists.content:
• Define quality frameworks, evaluation rubrics, thresholds, and methodologies for multilingual AI experiences.
  • Design and execute structured evaluations for AI-generated, AI-translated, AI-curated, and recommendation-driven experiences.
  • Lead multilingual dataset curation, annotation, enrichment, and ground-truth creation to support AI model development and evaluation.
  • Analyze evaluation results, identify quality gaps, and provide actionable recommendations to improve multilingual AI quality.
  • Support LLM-as-a-judge workflows, evaluator calibration, and human-AI agreement studies.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Research, Localization, vendors, and market experts to improve AI quality signals and inform launch decisions.
  • Document best practices and help define quality standards across languages, markets, and AI use cases.
  • Contribute to building scalable evaluation capabilities that support the next generation of AI-powered experiences across Spotify.

• You have experience in multilingual quality evaluation, localization, data curation, annotation, AI evaluation, or related fields, including text-to-text and text-to-speech experiences.
  • You understand language quality, cultural relevance, content quality, and user experience across multiple languages and markets.
  • You have experience designing or conducting structured evaluations using quality rubrics, audits, annotation projects, or review methodologies.
  • You are comfortable using qualitative and quantitative data to identify trends, measure quality, and make recommendations.
  • You are familiar with large language models (LLMs), generative AI evaluation, human-in-the-loop workflows, or LLM-as-a-judge methodologies.
  • You enjoy working through ambiguity and turning complex quality challenges into practical evaluation strategies.
  • You communicate effectively and thrive in highly cross-functional environments, collaborating with technical and non-technical partners alike.
  • Experience with recommendation systems, personalization, search, ranking, machine translation, generative AI, dataset creation, annotation operations, evaluator calibration, prompt testing, model evaluation, SQL, Python, dashboards, or annotation platforms is a plus.

• This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
We’re looking for a Senior C++/iOS Engineer to join the Baldur squad within User Platform (UP). Baldur owns Spotify’s Session Management and Delegated Authorization domains—the systems that enable applications to securely obtain, use, and manage access tokens for hundreds of millions of users. In this role, you’ll help shape the technology that powers secure access across every Spotify client and third-party integration. 
Your work will support engineers across Spotify building mobile and desktop experiences, platform teams, and third-party developers integrating with Spotify’s authorization platform. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to build secure, reliable, and scalable authentication experiences that have a direct impact on millions of people every day.
description:
We’re looking for a Senior C++/iOS Engineer to join the Baldur squad within User Platform (UP). Baldur owns Spotify’s Session Management and Delegated Authorization domains—the systems that enable applications to securely obtain, use, and manage access tokens for hundreds of millions of users. In this role, you’ll help shape the technology that powers secure access across every Spotify client and third-party integration. 

Your work will support engineers across Spotify building mobile and desktop experiences, platform teams, and third-party developers integrating with Spotify’s authorization platform. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to build secure, reliable, and scalable authentication experiences that have a direct impact on millions of people every day.

lists.content:
• Collaborate with a highly autonomous and supportive engineering squad responsible for Spotify’s delegated authorization and session management platforms.
  • Design, build, and evolve critical infrastructure powering Spotify applications and partner integrations using shared C++ libraries and native Swift on iOS.
  • Develop secure, reliable, and performant delegated authorization flows, including token issuance, refresh, revocation, and session lifecycle management across multiple platforms.
  • Partner with client and backend engineers to integrate with core authorization services, token issuance, client registration, and token revocation.
  • Improve how credentials and access tokens are securely stored and managed on-device while balancing security, reliability, and application performance.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Spotify’s authorization frameworks, Spotify-specific implementations, enabling new platforms and product experiences.
  • Drive technical improvements, share knowledge with teammates, and help shape the long-term technical direction of delegated authorization and session management.

• You have strong proficiency in C++, along with experience building native iOS applications in Swift, or you're excited to develop your expertise in Swift while applying your C++ skills.
  • You have experience designing, building, or maintaining security-sensitive systems such as authorization, authentication, token management, credential storage, or related platforms.
  • You bring a systems-thinking mindset and enjoy solving complex engineering challenges that span client and backend technologies.
  • You have a solid understanding of software architecture, secure system design, and modern authorization protocols such as OAuth 2.0.
  • You approach problems thoughtfully, with strong attention to detail and a focus on building secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy collaborating with engineers across multiple teams and technical disciplines.
  • You have experience working with shared cross-platform codebases and understand how native platform layers interact with common C++ libraries.
  • You enjoy working on large-scale distributed systems where your contributions improve experiences for hundreds of millions of Spotify users.

• This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design  and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive and unmistakably Spotify.
The In Home Hardware Partners team sits within the Experience Mission and connects Spotify engineering with some of our most strategic hardware partners. We help bring Spotify to connected devices by working closely with partners throughout integration, certification and launch. As the team continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Partner Engineer to help scale our technical partnerships and drive the next generation of Spotify experiences on connected devices.

We help bring Spotify to connected devices by working closely with partners throughout integration, certification and launch. As the team continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Partner Engineer to help scale our technical partnerships and drive the next generation of Spotify experiences on connected devices.

lists.content:
• Build trusted technical partnerships with strategic hardware manufacturers, including companies developing connected audio products.

  • Lead technical integration projects from planning through launch, helping partners successfully adopt Spotify's Core Playback SDK.

  • Collaborate with engineering, product and cross-functional teams to align priorities, remove blockers and deliver high-quality partner experiences.

  • Drive technical discussions, architecture reviews, workshops and implementation planning with both internal and external stakeholders.

  • Write clear technical proposals, RFCs and design documentation that help engineering teams make informed decisions.

  • Monitor project health, proactively identify risks and coordinate solutions across multiple engineering teams.

  • Investigate and resolve complex SDK, API and integration challenges, contributing code when appropriate.

  • Help improve the tools, processes and developer experience that enable partners to build with Spotify more effectively.

  • Contribute to the long-term evolution of Spotify's hardware platform by identifying opportunities to simplify integrations and scale partner success.

• You have a strong foundation in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • You have 5+ years of experience working in software engineering, partner engineering, developer relations, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role.

  • You are experienced with software development, SDKs, APIs, distributed systems or embedded technologies.

  • You can comfortably read, understand, and contribute to production code while discussing technical architecture with engineers and technical partners.

  • You have experience working across organizational boundaries and building strong relationships with both engineering teams and external partners.

  • You know how to navigate ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and keep complex technical initiatives moving forward.

  • You communicate technical concepts clearly, adapting your approach for different audiences without losing technical depth.

  • Experience with consumer electronics, connected devices, smart home products, audio platforms or hardware certification is valuable.

  • Experience writing technical specifications, architecture proposals or RFCs is an advantage.

• This role is based in Stockholm.

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the strategy and evolution of Encore, Spotify's design system. In this role, you'll define the vision and roadmap for the design infrastructure that powers product development across the company.
You'll work at the intersection of design, engineering, accessibility, and artificial intelligence, ensuring that our systems are built not only for the people using them today, but also for the AI-assisted workflows shaping how software will be built tomorrow.
This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strategic thinking, strong product judgment, and the ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives through influence. You'll partner closely with engineering, design, research, and leadership to align priorities, make thoughtful trade-offs, and drive measurable outcomes across Spotify's product ecosystem.
description:
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the strategy and evolution of Encore, Spotify's design system. In this role, you'll define the vision and roadmap for the design infrastructure that powers product development across the company.

You'll work at the intersection of design, engineering, accessibility, and artificial intelligence, ensuring that our systems are built not only for the people using them today, but also for the AI-assisted workflows shaping how software will be built tomorrow.

This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strategic thinking, strong product judgment, and the ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives through influence. You'll partner closely with engineering, design, research, and leadership to align priorities, make thoughtful trade-offs, and drive measurable outcomes across Spotify's product ecosystem.

lists.content:
• Define and drive the long-term product strategy and roadmap for Encore, including design tokens, component libraries, accessibility standards, and AI-powered capabilities.
  • Partner closely with engineering, design, accessibility, and platform teams to evolve the systems that enable product teams to deliver high-quality user experiences consistently and efficiently.
  • Lead prioritization across multiple initiatives, balancing immediate customer needs with long-term platform investments while clearly communicating trade-offs and rationale to stakeholders.
  • Champion the use of AI throughout the product development lifecycle, leveraging AI-powered tools to synthesize research, explore solutions, draft product artifacts, accelerate decision-making, and improve team productivity.
  • Shape Spotify's strategy for AI-enabled design tooling, identifying opportunities where AI can meaningfully improve design workflows, component quality, documentation, and adoption across both human and AI consumers.
  • Establish meaningful success metrics for platform adoption, design quality, accessibility, and developer experience, using both quantitative and qualitative insights to guide investment decisions.
  • Translate strategic objectives into clear execution plans that keep cross-functional teams aligned, focused, and delivering against shared outcomes.
  • Build trusted partnerships across Spotify, helping teams successfully adopt Encore while continuously improving the platform based on user feedback and evolving business needs.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, experimentation, and accountability across the teams contributing to Spotify's design infrastructure.

• You have 6+ years of experience in Product Management, with significant experience building platform, infrastructure, developer platform, or design systems products.
  • You have successfully defined product strategy for complex, cross-functional initiatives involving platform adoption, migrations, or large-scale technical investments.
  • You use AI tools as a natural part of your product management practice, applying them to research, analysis, documentation, synthesis, prototyping, and decision support while exercising thoughtful human judgment.
  • You have strong analytical skills and experience defining product metrics, interpreting data, and using evidence to inform product strategy and prioritization.
  • You understand the principles behind design systems, accessibility, design tokens, semantic components, and modern design tooling, or you're excited to deepen your expertise in these areas.
  • You communicate complex ideas with clarity, adapting your approach to engineers, designers, executives, and cross-functional partners alike.
  • You know how to influence without authority, bringing alignment across multiple teams with differing priorities.
  • You care deeply about building products that enable others to do their best work, raising the quality, consistency, and accessibility of experiences across Spotify.
  • You thrive in ambiguous environments, bringing curiosity, sound judgment, and a bias toward thoughtful execution.

• This role is based in Stockholm or London.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
